rubrics.justification: It gives a plausible stage 3/A/A description, but it likely over-interprets the image by asserting vacuoles, inclusions, fragmentation, and downgrading to 3AB–3BA without clear support from the provided lab grade/image context.
It integrates age, ovarian response, endometrium, male factor, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality reasonably well, though some links are overstated.

The structure is logical, but several deductions are weakly supported, especially the quantitative penalties for alcohol, BMI, activity, and image-based defects, making the probability model somewhat speculative.

Many recommendations are standard (proceed with SET, luteal support, follow-up, consider reserve testing), but routine PGT-A after one failure, ERA after 2 failures, and strong claims about alcohol/exercise/BMI effects are more assertive than guideline-based.
Provides clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, follow-up testing, and additional workup, though some suggested interventions are not strongly indicated in this exact case.
